title: Sens. Mark Warner and Josh Hawley introduce a bipartisan bill that would require companies and US agencies to submit quarterly reports on AI-related job impacts (Annie Palmer/CNBC)
summary: Annie Palmer /CNBC:Sens. Mark Warner and Josh Hawley introduce a bipartisan bill that would require companies and US agencies to submit quarterly reports on AI-related job impacts—  A new bipartisan bill seeks to provide a “clear picture” of how artificial intelligence is affecting the American workforce.
